limitations: Only Claude tool-free structured responses are supported for autonomous agents; Codex tool confinement is unavailable. No agent shell, filesystem tools, MCP, subagents, or session resume. Bare/restricted mode and disabled hooks/customizations are required; the default first-party API endpoint is the only supported backend.

Daemon may read authorized regular files (256 KiB each, 1 MiB total) and pinned project context, and create/replace authorized regular UTF-8 files inside assigned worktrees. No deletes, links, mode changes, hidden paths or protected instruction/configuration edits.

Only the exact configured verification argv may run, inside the recorded local sandbox with a cleared environment, no network, and no unrelated user-home file contents. System runtimes and the assigned checkout are readable; checkout and per-command temporary storage are writable. Sandbox availability is required; no unsandboxed fallback. Preflight may run help-only provider probes and a fixed sandboxed /usr/bin/true capability probe.

Owned worktree creation, dependency merges, immutable-tree preservation and optional local integration are permitted. Remote push, publishing, production deployment, main merge, credentials, dependency installation and arbitrary external operations are excluded.

Provider/model arguments and time/attempt/review/concurrency limits are enforced. Tool-free prompts, including full review diffs, are limited to 64 KiB; larger work blocks. Token/monetary accounting and spending caps are unavailable; provider defaults and inference charges cannot be certified. The trusted tool-free provider uses its configured API credentials in bare mode; OAuth subscription login and alternate cloud/custom backends are unsupported. Autono never reads or exposes credential values.

Authorization expires by wall-clock deadline from consent, including idle time. Crash/restart interrupts active runs and never resumes or blindly replays uncertain effects. Same-UID hostile processes and trusted installed provider binaries remain inside the local trust boundary.
